Apps & settings

Open any app, any setting, and move text around.

EssentialsRuns on: Your phoneOn for a fresh install

Every tool in this connector

Opens apps, the camera and settings, uses the clipboard and shows notifications. Ultron picks the right tool from what you say, so you never have to name one.
